subject: MAP & Eval: Tie-out checklist for MSA/DPA + Order Form cadence
messages:
From: Daniel Park <dpark@aureliahealth.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Aurelia Health Procurement <procurement@aureliahealth.com>
Date: 2026-08-30T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: MAP & sequencing — MSA/DPA/order form cadence

Hi Laura,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — team was impressed with the latency profile. Procurement asked me to pull together a single mutual action plan (MAP) that ties the evaluation milestones to legal/procurement gates so we can see a realistic path to signature. Key asks from our side:

- We need a clear sequencing for MSA, DPA redlines, and the order form (who signs first, whether order form can be conditional on DPA).
- Estimated legal review windows (legal at Aurelia typically needs ~10 business days for standard review).
- Acceptance criteria for the pilot we complete during eval (what constitutes technical sign-off).
- Any security evidence or SOC2 artifacts we should include up front.

I attached our MAP template (Aurelia_MAP_template.xlsx). Can you return a proposed timeline with owners? Target: close before the end of Q3 if feasible.

Thanks,
Daniel
Daniel Park
Senior Procurement Manager
Aurelia Health
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
To: Daniel Park <dpark@aureliahealth.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-08-30T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP & sequencing — MSA/DPA/order form cadence

Daniel — appreciate the clear asks. I pulled a draft MAP and sequencing and attached Redwood_MAP_v1.xlsx (high level). Proposed cadence (high level):

1) Technical eval sign-off (pilot acceptance) — owner: Aurelia engineering + Redwood CS. Target: Sept 3
2) MSA execution (commercial terms handshake) — owner: Aurelia procurement + Redwood legal/account. Target: Sept 10
3) DPA finalization (privacy/security redlines) — owner: Aurelia legal + Redwood legal; parallel review permitted but DPA must be agreed before order form effective date. Target: Sept 17
4) Order form signature (commits billing and start date) — owner: Aurelia signatory + Redwood sales. Target: Sept 17 (same day as DPA completion, if possible)

Notes / caveats:
- If Aurelia legal needs longer than 10 business days, we can push the DPA window and run a brief pilot extension.
- We can stage an early limited-production pilot under a short-term addendum while legal completes DPA, but that requires explicit config: isolated dataset, no PHI ingestion, and restricted access.
- Acceptance criteria (see acceptance_test_plan.md attached): sample throughput targets, Latency P95 under 400ms on standard prompt set, and two reproducible eval prompts passing accuracy thresholds.

Next steps I recommend:
- Karthik, can you confirm Redwood legal availability for a DPA review and whether the SOC2 artifacts in our folder are sufficient?
- Marcus, can you confirm the onboarding window and the test dataset requirements from our infra side?

I'll update the MAP with owners and push a HubSpot milestone entry for the target dates.

Best,
Laura Bennett
Account Executive — Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Daniel Park <dpark@aureliahealth.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-08-30T11:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP & sequencing — MSA/DPA/order form cadence

Thanks Laura / Daniel — looping in legal comments up front to avoid surprises. High-level legal position and suggested timeline: 

- DPA review: Redwood legal can turn initial redlines around in ~5 business days if we receive Aurelia's redline copy by EOD Aug 31. Full negotiation typically 7–12 business days depending on subprocessor & data locality asks.
- Must-have items from Aurelia's side to expedite: concrete data flow diagram, classification of datasets, and whether the pilot will include PHI. If PHI is involved, we need the BAA conversation (separate scope).
- Key redline items to watch: data deletion obligations, subprocessors list, breach notification SLA, and international transfer mechanisms. Note: we prefer SCCs or UK Addendum for transfers; EQs for EU customers may add time.

Action: please upload Aurelia's DPA redlines to the shared Drive link and I'll prioritize review. If we need an exception to standard timelines (e.g., 48-hour turn), Laura please flag escalation and we can route to the GC.

Karthik Iyer
Senior Counsel, Contracts — Redwood Inference
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwoodinference.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Daniel Park <dpark@aureliahealth.com>
Date: 2026-08-30T13:00:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP & sequencing — MSA/DPA/order form cadence

Adding a quick infra/acceptance note. To hit the Sept 3 technical sign-off we need the following from Aurelia by Sept 1: 

- Access credentials for a non-PHI test tenant (or sanitized dataset)
- A short acceptance test harness (or specs) with 10 representative prompts and expected outputs/thresholds
- A decision owner at Aurelia engineering who can acknowledge sign-off within 24 hours of tests completing

We can run the test profile during a two-day window; if the metrics meet the thresholds (P95 latency and accuracy check) we will produce a one-page acceptance report that can be used for progression to MSA. If Aurelia prefers, we can also run a canary for a single route to validate production configuration while legal concludes DPA.

Marcus Lin
Senior Solutions Engineer — Redwood Inference
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
To: Daniel Park <dpark@aureliahealth.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwoodinference.com>, Aurelia Health Procurement <procurement@aureliahealth.com>
Date: 2026-08-30T14:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP & sequencing — MSA/DPA/order form cadence

Perfect — thanks all. I updated the attached Redwood_MAP_v1.xlsx with explicit owners and dates and created the HubSpot milestone (link above). Summary of immediate next steps (owners & dates):

- Aurelia: upload DPA redlines + data flow diagram (owner: Daniel) — due Aug 31
- Redwood Legal: initial pass on DPA redlines (owner: Karthik) — target Sep 6
- Aurelia Eng: provide sanitized test dataset or non-PHI tenant + acceptance spec (owner: TBD) — due Sep 1
- Redwood SE: run acceptance test window and deliver acceptance report (owner: Marcus) — run Sep 2–3
- Commercial: MSA handshake and order form prep (owner: Laura) — target Sep 10

Target close / fully executed documents: Sep 17, 2026 (conditional on DPA turnaround). If Aurelia needs a faster outcome we can discuss a limited addendum to start a restricted pilot earlier; will need procurement/legal sign-off on scope.

I'll follow up with a short calendar invite for a MAP review on Aug 31 to lock owners.

Regards,
Laura Bennett
Account Executive — Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com
